receipt.result_detail: voice.exp2 challenger court over 2 held-out cases of 7de2453d2b249130b2edff2b457fcc29a37eb200215387aac82debec4200c6fa (codec under test: vole.audio.stream.voice.exp1 control): quality-at-equal-rate vs Opus -4.54 dB SNR / -2.61 MOS, vs EVS -4.39 / -2.59, vs Lyra n/a / n/a; bitrate-at-equal-quality vs Opus +2.72 dB, vs EVS +3.39 dB, vs Lyra n/a dB (n/a where the quality ranges do not overlap); matched-bitrate SNR vs Opus -6.35 dB; encode p99 6069 µs; the profile is lossy and makes no exactness claim; result sha256 23eaf3610af66d789bb188aedd6e1359ba9ac06ba706d691a2f853845588d43c
limitations: learned prediction is an experimental profile: it does not change u1/v1, the literal fallback remains mandatory, and negative learned results are preserved rather than hidden

lyra.rate_reason: snr: no competitor operating point lies inside the shared quality range; visqol: no competitor operating point lies inside the shared quality range

harness.codec_under_test_note: voice.exp1 is the labelled control until 7C.2-C lands voice.exp2
harness.metric: quality-at-equal-rate (SNR dB, ViSQOL MOS) plus bitrate-at-equal-quality (dB), integrated over the shared rate range with the monotone quality envelope
harness.note: competitors are external processes; no code is imported, linked, wrapped or used as a fallback

integrated_metrics.interpretation: quality deltas are VOLE minus competitor at equal rate (negative = VOLE worse); bitrate deltas are dB of rate at equal quality (negative = VOLE needs fewer bits)

limitations: the held-out corpus is read speech only: no whisper/breath, no realistic background noise, no non-English speech; broader claims are blocked until more rights-clean speaker-disjoint material is frozen
the codec under test is the voice.exp1 control until the voice.exp2 profile lands (7C.2-C)
integrated deltas are computed over the competitor's measured quality range only; no extrapolation
Opus and Lyra expose no packet-loss simulation through their pinned CLIs, so their loss behaviour is NOT_AVAILABLE rather than guessed
ViSQOL speech mode is applied where the pinned binary and model run; absent cells are null

protocol.semantic_authority: none: a learned hypothesis is a candidate family, never truth; scalar exact closure decides acceptance
